svg.text: Linear combinations 12x + 8y form 4ℤ; gcd(12, 8) = 4 is its generator
Ideal characterization: Gcd(12, 8) = { g ∈ ℕ | g > 0 ∧ 12ℤ + 8ℤ = gℤ } = { 4 }
Each input alone generates a coarse lattice of multiples:
Interfering strides +12 and −8 carve out a finer regular lattice of step g = 4:
No combination can land inside the gap (0, 4).
